photons travel through a vacuum only
charge hops through a metal only
questions.explanation: Hot fluid is less dense, rises, and carries internal energy with it. That bulk movement is convection.

questions.prompt: In isobaric process Q = ΔU.
questions.explanation: Isobaric means constant pressure, so the gas can change volume and do work. Q = ΔU + W, not Q = ΔU. Q = ΔU is isochoric (constant volume).

questions.prompt: In an isochoric process the volume is constant, so W = 0 and Q = ΔU.
questions.explanation: Isochoric means constant volume. No expansion work, so W = 0 and all heat changes the internal energy.

questions.prompt: An isobaric process takes place at constant pressure.
questions.explanation: Iso-baric means constant pressure. Iso-choric is constant volume. Iso-thermal is constant temperature.

questions.prompt: For an isobaric expansion, Q equals
questions.explanation: At constant pressure the gas expands and does work, so Q = ΔU + W. Q = ΔU only if W = 0 (isochoric).
